## Use case

Who needs this, and what task would it enable?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful scope, alternatives, and what should stay out of scope.

## Acceptance evidence

How would we demonstrate the result? Identify architecture, licensing, security, or classroom-schedule implications.

## Related work

Link roadmap milestones, requirements, or SN task IDs.
